auth.setupHint: First run: create the admin account. Credentials stay in the local data directory (webui/auth.json).
auth.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
auth.needSetup: Not initialized yet. Create the admin account first.

gravitas.title: Gravitas control status
gravitas.subtitle: Read-only diagnostic snapshot; viewing it does not probe dependencies or update policy.
gravitas.unavailable: The current process has not provided Gravitas status.
gravitas.noFacts: There are no facts to display.
gravitas.noAckItems: No adapter acknowledgements; policy application acknowledgement is not wired yet.

offline.title: Backend is not running
offline.hint: Cannot reach the Stella bot process. Desktop users: start the bot from the desktop shell first. Browser users: verify the address and port.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: Adapters and connections
platforms.intro: Choose the platforms Stella should connect to, enter the bot details, and review active connections.
platforms.addedHint: Only selected platforms appear here. Add platforms as needed, then choose Runtime settings on a card to enter its connection details. Use the status icon beside the title to review adapter connections.
platforms.adapterConfigHint: The form follows the selected adapter. Closing this dialog keeps the draft; use Save platform settings at the bottom of the page to write it to the local .env file.
platforms.genericAdapterConfigHint: This module has no catalog form preset. You can still add environment variables from its project docs below.
platforms.addDialogHint: Search for platforms to connect, or add an adapter outside the catalog below.
platforms.noAdaptersAdded: No platforms added yet. Choose Add adapter to select the platforms Stella should connect to.
platforms.legacyUnavailable: The saved configuration includes blocked adapters: {names}. Stella skips them at startup. Remove the corresponding cards and save to clean up the configuration.

unavailableReasons.walleQ: The upstream project has been inactive for a long time and requires an older OneBot adapter that conflicts with Stella's core dependency.
unavailableReasons.ntchat: The upstream project has been inactive for a long time and pins an older httpx version that conflicts with Stella's current NoneBot dependency stack.
unavailableReasons.requiresPython311: This adapter requires Python 3.11 or newer; the current installer Python version does not satisfy it.

platforms.noAdaptersFound: No matching platforms. Change the search or add a custom adapter above.
platforms.officialDocsTooltip: Open this adapter's project page or configuration docs
platforms.secretHint: Saved credentials are never shown for security. Leave blank to keep the current value.
platforms.onebotGuide: Run a OneBot implementation such as NapCat separately and make its WebSocket settings match Stella.
platforms.qqWebsocket: Use the QQ Official WebSocket gateway
platforms.qqIntents: Subscribed events (must match QQ Open Platform permissions)
platforms.webhookHint: Webhooks require a publicly reachable HTTPS URL and matching reverse proxy configuration.
platforms.discordMessageContentHint: Reading ordinary message content requires enabling Message Content Intent in the Discord Developer Portal.
platforms.registerAllCommands: Register all application commands in every server
platforms.customModulesHint: Enter the Python module path of an installed adapter. It will appear in the platform list after adding.
platforms.customModuleInvalid: Enter a valid Python module path, for example package_name.adapter.
platforms.customModuleDuplicate: This custom adapter has already been added.
platforms.customModuleBlocked: This adapter is blocked and cannot be added.
platforms.adapterEnvHint: Environment variables are bound to the current adapter module. Catalog adapters include common fields from their project docs; add extra or custom fields below. Sensitive values are not returned, and Stella or dedicated form fields are protected.
platforms.presetBotEmpty: No configuration entries yet. Select Add bot / account to get started.
platforms.presetListHint: Enter one item per line. The value is saved in the list format expected by the adapter.
platforms.adapterEnvUnassignedHint: These settings came from the previous Platforms page and have no adapter association. Choose a target card to assign them; leaving them unassigned preserves the existing configuration.
platforms.adapterEnvProcessOverride: Higher-priority process or environment settings override these .env entries: {keys}. Editing this page cannot change the override source; remove it and restart to use the saved values.
platforms.driverSharedHint: DRIVER is a global NoneBot setting. Changes here apply to every selected adapter; editing it from any adapter's runtime settings has the same effect.
platforms.driverHint: Leave blank to keep the current default. The required driver depends on the adapter and connection mode.
platforms.useRecommendedDriver: Use the suggested remote platform driver
platforms.driverOverride: The process environment variable DRIVER overrides the saved value.
platforms.remoteDriverHint: Remote HTTP / WebSocket platforms usually need a compatible ForwardDriver and client dependencies. The suggested value is ~fastapi+~httpx+~websockets; verify it against the selected adapter's docs.
platforms.saved: Platform settings saved. Restart to apply.
platforms.loadFailed: Current platform settings could not be loaded. Saving is disabled to prevent overwriting them. Check the connection and retry.
platforms.backendUpdateRequired: This page can read legacy OneBot settings, but this backend cannot yet save the new platform forms or report package status. Restart Stella and refresh to enable them.

intent.c2c_group_at_messages: User and group messages that mention the bot

platforms.modulesLabel: Python module paths (one per line or comma-separated)
platforms.modulesHint: Default: nonebot.adapters.onebot.v11. Changes take effect after restart. An empty list disables all Bot adapters. This field does not install modules or accept credentials.
platforms.processOverride: A process environment variable overrides the module list in .env. The saved value takes effect after removing that override.
platforms.modulesSaved: Adapter modules saved; restart to apply
platforms.onebotConfigHint: Multiple forward WebSocket URLs are supported. The access token is never returned; leave it blank to keep the current value.
platforms.onebotSaved: OneBot settings saved; restart to apply
platforms.connectionStatusHint: The list shows Bot connections active in this process. OneBot V11 reports heartbeat and active-probe health; other adapters report connection state only, so health is unknown.
platforms.noOnebotNeeded: OneBot V11 is not enabled. NapCat link checks do not apply; Stella can still use other configured adapters or WebChat.
platforms.onebotNotReady: The OneBot V11 link is not ready. Check that the adapter is enabled and that NapCat's WebSocket address matches this service.
platforms.noConnections: There are no connected Bot instances.
platforms.host: Listen address (reverse mode; use 0.0.0.0 for a remote adapter)
platforms.wsUrlsHint: Use one ws:// or wss:// URL per line or comma-separated; leave blank for reverse WS.
platforms.accessTokenHint: Must match the adapter-side value; blank leaves the current token unchanged.
platforms.restartHint: Changes are unsaved. Save to write them to the local .env file, then restart Stella to apply.
